key_idea: Only whether the minimum a and maximum b already appear in the log matters.
sketch: Scan the n-1 entries and note whether a and b occur. If both occur the missing entry can be any value in [a,b]; if only one is missing the entry must be that one; if both are missing the answer is a when a==b and otherwise -1. O(n). The a==b corner is the only trap (in practice both are then present since n>=2 and all entries lie in [a,b]).
